product.name: Software Before Code
product.primaryLine: Determine the object before selecting the mechanism.
product.secondaryLine: Find what must survive before choosing how to build it.
product.coreProposition: Software is a computational representation of a domain joined to an executable process. Code is the operational material of that representation, not the whole engineered object.
product.engineeringMaxim: Own the problem complexity; do not create code complexity.

hero.title: Determine the object before selecting the mechanism.
hero.deck: Teams often choose frameworks, schemas, services, APIs, queues, classes, tickets, and deployment structures before agreeing on what the system must preserve. Software Before Code reverses that order.
hero.support: Discover the domain, consequential distinctions, admissible transformations, protected invariants, boundaries, witnesses, and closure conditions; then choose implementation structure.

opening.title: Code is not the first software artifact.
opening.body: Software engineering begins with a representation of a domain and a theory of lawful change inside it. Implementation is where that representation becomes executable.

coreObject.proposition: Software is a computational representation of a domain and an executable process acting inside that domain. Code is the material in which that representation is made operational; it is not the whole object being engineered.
coreObject.qualityRule: Good software is a representation whose declared invariants survive admissible execution, composition, deployment, use, failure, and repair.

problem.title: Most software arguments begin downstream.
problem.diagnosis: Those decisions become brittle when the team has not yet found the distinctions, invariants, and closure conditions the mechanisms are supposed to protect.

notBigDesignUpFront.title: Before code does not mean before learning.
notBigDesignUpFront.body: The method does not demand perfect requirements before implementation. It asks what must be known before a particular commitment becomes safe, and it learns through probes, prototypes, artifacts, execution, observation, and witness.

nineQuestions.name: Representation
nineQuestions.question: What world does the system claim to represent, and what does it omit?

nineQuestions.name: Distinction
nineQuestions.question: Which differences must remain visible, and which may be collapsed?

nineQuestions.name: Boundary
nineQuestions.question: Where does interaction occur and under what crossing conditions?

nineQuestions.name: Admissibility
nineQuestions.question: Which states, operations, transitions, and compositions are lawful?

nineQuestions.name: Closure
nineQuestions.question: What makes the process complete enough for the domain to recognize, verify, and use?

nineQuestions.name: Defect
nineQuestions.question: Which forgotten distinction returns as failure, residue, exception, or harm?

nineQuestions.name: Witness
nineQuestions.question: Who or what verifies the system's claim?

nineQuestions.name: Consequence
nineQuestions.question: Who receives the gain, cost, risk, or repair burden?

deliverySkeleton.title: Build the smallest path that can tell the truth.
requirements: expose at least one failure path

doctrine: Booleans are claims of binary adequacy.
Good translation is selective, not total.

controlledForgetting.title: Representation is controlled forgetting.
controlledForgetting.body: Every useful software representation makes the world smaller. A database row forgets most of a person. An API response forgets most of a database. A UI forgets implementation. A cache forgets freshness within tolerance. A queue forgets synchronous timing while preserving other semantics.
controlledForgetting.rule: Forgetting becomes a defect when the system collapses a distinction that execution still needs.
controlledForgetting.line: A boundary is a licensed forgetting operator; a defect is the residue of a distinction forgotten without license.

flagship.title: Invoice Approval
protectedInvariants: payment cannot release without authority and evidence
duplicates cannot independently close without review
approved identifies authority, time, policy, and evidence
reported success is reconstructable from audit
flagship.publicationLine: Binary storage is easy; semantic adequacy is difficult; grammatical validity is consequential; closure is stronger than completion.

booleanChallenge.title: Every boolean makes a promise.
booleanChallenge.body: A boolean claims the domain distinction is adequately binary for every operation that depends on it. When the real domain contains independent dimensions, authority, evidence, time, revocation, or partial completion, the boolean may hide the state machine rather than simplify it.

diagnostics.repair: model the artifact and repair loop

architecture.title: Architecture is invariant protection.
architecture.body: Architecture is justified when it protects consequential distinctions, responsibilities, admissible composition, observability, and repair across execution boundaries.

agile.title: Iteration is an observational system.
agile.body: Agile is useful when it shortens the distance between representation, execution, witness, and correction. It fails when it becomes productivity theater detached from learning and closure.

closure.title: Done is a claim. Closure needs a witness.

ai.title: AI makes Software Before Code more important, not less.
ai.body: As implementation becomes cheaper, the cost of choosing the wrong representation becomes proportionally more important. Cheap code increases the value of knowing what the code is supposed to preserve.

validation.immediateExperiment: Compare baseline and Boundary First invoice-approval designs against a 25-fault mutation set and measure detection before deployment.
validation.claimRule: Formalism is a tool for consequence, not a ritual of sophistication.

architecture: /work — Show me where you've used it.
/evidence — Show me what you actually know.
siteRelationship.bookRole: The book is the durable canonical long-form source for the method, not the product identity itself.

notThis: claim of proof of correctness without a bounded proof system

closing.title: Find what must survive. Then build.
closing.finalLine: Code is the mechanism. The system comes first.
